newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn cattle not well established - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn cattle not well established - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were not well established, compared with Monday's close, USDA said. Trade slow. Demand and seller interest light. Offerings light.
Steers - Select and Choice 2-4 1200-1300 lbs few 69.00-70.00. Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 no sls.
